cases.feature_description: User login with username and password, including invalid credentials and account lockout after repeated failed attempts.

existing_cases.title: Login with valid credentials succeeds
existing_cases.description: Enter a valid username and password and submit; the user is logged in.

existing_cases.title: Login with invalid password shows an error
existing_cases.description: Enter a valid username with a wrong password; an invalid-credentials error is shown.

cases.feature_description: Self-service password reset via an emailed reset link, including expired links and links that have already been used once.

existing_cases.title: Password reset link is emailed on request
existing_cases.description: Requesting a reset for a known email sends a reset link.

existing_cases.title: Expired reset link is rejected
existing_cases.description: Following a reset link after it has expired shows an error, not the reset form.

cases.feature_description: Exporting a test suite's test cases and each one's latest run status to a CSV file, including suites that have zero test cases.

existing_cases.title: Export a populated suite produces a CSV with one row per test case
existing_cases.description: Exporting a suite with test cases downloads a CSV listing each case and its latest status.

existing_cases.title: Export an empty suite produces a header-only CSV
existing_cases.description: Exporting a suite with zero test cases downloads a CSV with just the header row.

cases.feature_description: Paginated, searchable list of test suites within a project, filterable by name substring.

existing_cases.title: Search filters the suite list by name substring
existing_cases.description: Typing part of a suite's name narrows the list to matching suites.

existing_cases.title: Pagination shows the next page of suites
existing_cases.description: Clicking next advances to the next page of results when more suites exist than fit one page.

cases.feature_description: Bulk-selecting multiple test suites and deleting them in one action, including a partial-failure case where one suite fails to delete.

existing_cases.title: Bulk delete removes all selected suites
existing_cases.description: Selecting several suites and confirming bulk delete removes every selected suite.

existing_cases.title: Bulk delete reports a partial failure
existing_cases.description: If one selected suite fails to delete, the others still succeed and the failure is reported.

cases.feature_description: Managing the fixed staging/regression/preprod/prod environment pipeline, including assigning a run to an environment.

existing_cases.title: A run can be assigned to an environment
existing_cases.description: Creating a run lets the user pick one of the four environments.

existing_cases.title: Environments are listed in pipeline order
existing_cases.description: The environments list shows staging, regression, preprod, and prod in that order.
